"C'mon friend, take a turn tossing the knucklebones. What've you got to lose?"
—Tobias, trader of Erdwal

faces.name: Dark Deal
faces.oracleText: Each player discards all the cards in their hand, then draws that many cards minus one.
faces.flavorText: Dungeon Master's Guide, *Revised 5th Edition, cover art sketch (2024)*

faces.name: Darksteel Pendant
faces.oracleText:
Indestructible (Effects that say "destroy" don't destroy this artifact.)
{1}, {T}: Scry 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card on the bottom.)

faces.name: Dauthi Embrace
faces.oracleText: {B}{B}: Target creature gains shadow until end of turn. (It can block or be blocked by only creatures with shadow.)
faces.flavorText:
"The Dauthi army grows by screams and bounds."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

faces.name: Dauthi Trapper
faces.oracleText: {T}: Target creature gains shadow until end of turn. (It can block or be blocked by only creatures with shadow.)
faces.flavorText: Merfolk tell their young of Dandân, humans of Rag Man. Dal tell tales of the Dauthi, and they are far worse.

faces.name: Day of Judgment
faces.oracleText: Destroy all creatures.

faces.name: Dead of Winter
faces.oracleText: All nonsnow creatures get -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of snow permanents you control.
faces.flavorText:
"At last, silence."
—Tevesh Szat

faces.name: Deadly Tempest
faces.oracleText: Destroy all creatures. Each player loses life equal to the number of creatures they controlled that were destroyed this way.
faces.flavorText: When the winds blow out of the abyss, death is the only harvest.

faces.name: Death Begets Life
faces.oracleText: Destroy all creatures and enchantments. Draw a card for each permanent destroyed this way.
faces.flavorText:
"Life ensures death. Death ensures life. Yet always I remain. Perhaps an abiding harvest needs an ageless shepherd."
—Ugin

faces.name: Death Grasp
faces.oracleText: Death Grasp deals X damage to any target. You gain X life.
faces.flavorText: Yawgmoth's greatest joy came from watching one hero defeat another.

faces.name: Death Wind
faces.oracleText: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn.
faces.flavorText: Leukin stared at the smoldering angel feathers. "Run!" he screamed to his patrol. "We don't stand a chance!"

faces.name: Death's Caress
faces.oracleText: Destroy target creature. If that creature was a Human, you gain life equal to its toughness.
faces.flavorText: The faint smell of cloves, the rustling of the wind, and a paralyzing descent into an airless, fathomless tomb.

faces.name: Deathless Angel
faces.oracleText:
Flying
{W}{W}: Target creature gains indestructible until end of turn.
faces.flavorText:
"I should have died that day, but I suffered not a scratch. I awoke in a lake of blood, none of it apparently my own."
—*The War Diaries*

faces.name: Ohran Viper
faces.oracleText:
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a creature, destroy that creature at end of combat.
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may draw a card.
faces.flavorText: The ohran viper is not cold-blooded. Its veins course with the same antigelid venom used to kill its prey.

faces.name: Debt to the Deathless
faces.oracleText: Each opponent loses two times X life. You gain life equal to the life lost this way.
faces.flavorText: Some of Orzhov's cruelest collectors remember their debtors by taste alone.

faces.name: Decimate
faces.oracleText: Destroy target artifact, target creature, target enchantment, and target land. (You can't cast this spell unless you have legal choices for all its targets.)
faces.flavorText: Tormented by her own existence, Karona turned her wrath on the world that had birthed her.

faces.name: Declaration in Stone
faces.oracleText: Exile target creature and all other creatures its controller controls with the same name as that creature. That player investigates for each nontoken creature exiled this way.

faces.name: Deconstruct
faces.oracleText: Destroy target artifact. Add {G}{G}{G}.
faces.flavorText: "Nothing in this world, not even magic, likes to be caged."

faces.name: Deduce
faces.oracleText: Draw a card. Investigate. (Create a Clue token. It's an artifact with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")
faces.flavorText:
「異常を見落としてはならない。そこに謎を解く鍵があることが多いからだ。」
――アルキスト・プロフトの捜査日誌

faces.name: Defibrillating Current
faces.oracleText: Defibrillating Current deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker and you gain 2 life.
faces.flavorText:
A small shock to save a life, a large one to take it away.
—Mardu healer's adage

faces.name: Defile
faces.oracleText: Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn for each Swamp you control.
faces.flavorText: The only shortcut in a bog is to the bottom.

faces.name: Delete
faces.oracleText: Delete deals X damage to each nonartifact creature and each player.
faces.flavorText: "You will be deleted."

faces.name: Deluge
faces.oracleText: Tap all creatures without flying.
faces.flavorText:
"From the sea came all life, and to the sea it will return. The sooner the better."
—Emperor Aboshan

faces.name: Deluge of Doom
faces.oracleText: All creatures get -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of card types among cards in your graveyard.
faces.flavorText:
"I told you there were no razorkin down that passage. I never said it was *safe*."
—Winter

faces.name: Demolish
faces.oracleText: Destroy target artifact or land.
faces.flavorText:
"Pound the steel until it fits. Doesn't work? Bash to bits."
—Dwarven forging song

faces.name: Demon's Due
faces.oracleText: Scry 2, then draw two cards. You lose 2 life.
faces.flavorText: Ob Nixilis extends his hand not in partnership, but to affirm your subservience.

faces.name: Depopulate
faces.oracleText: Each player who controls a multicolored creature draws a card. Then destroy all creatures.
faces.flavorText: No screams rang out. No blood stained the streets. In an instant, the bustling metropolis simply fell silent.

faces.name: Depressurize
faces.oracleText: Target creature gets -3/-0 until end of turn. Then if that creature's power is 0 or less, destroy it.
faces.flavorText: The Sunstar faith teaches of Perfect Void—of emptying oneself so that the light may fill the hollow. But in the void of death, its teachings bring little comfort.

faces.name: Desecration Plague
faces.oracleText: Destroy target enchantment or land.
faces.flavorText:
"The gods think of us as insects. Perhaps there is wisdom in that."
—Perisophia the philosopher

faces.name: Desert Sandstorm
faces.oracleText: Desert Sandstorm deals 1 damage to each creature.
faces.flavorText: While pursuing the remnants of Yuan Shao's forces into the Wuhan Desert, Cao Cao was temporarily turned back by a fierce sandstorm.

faces.name: Desert's Due
faces.oracleText: Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. It gets an additional -1/-1 until end of turn for each Desert you control.
faces.flavorText: He was glad when the mirages appeared. At least he wouldn't die alone.

faces.name: Sunscorched Desert
faces.oracleText:
When this land enters, it deals 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.
{T}: Add {C}.

faces.name: Despoil
faces.oracleText: Destroy target land. Its controller loses 2 life.
faces.flavorText: Nothing could grow where the vile smoke had been, and no one could breathe it and live.

faces.name: Destroy the Evidence
faces.oracleText: Destroy target land. Its controller reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then puts those cards into their graveyard.
faces.flavorText: Everyone knew the Dimir had done the damage. Everyone suspected the Izzet had hired them.

faces.name: Destructive Revelry
faces.oracleText: Destroy target artifact or enchantment. Destructive Revelry deals 2 damage to that permanent's controller.

faces.name: Desynchronization
faces.oracleText: Return each nonland permanent that's not historic to its owner's hand. (Artifacts, legendaries, and Sagas are historic.)
faces.flavorText: History cannot be changed, and the Animus is not kind to those who try.

faces.name: Devastate
faces.oracleText: Destroy target land. Devastate deals 1 damage to each creature and each player.
faces.flavorText:
"You're willing to die for your homeland. I'm willing to kill for it."
—Latulla, Keldon overseer

faces.name: Devastation
faces.oracleText: Destroy all creatures and lands.
faces.flavorText: There is much talk about the art of creation. What about the art of destruction?

faces.name: Devour in Shadow
faces.oracleText: Destroy target creature. It can't be regenerated. You lose life equal to that creature's toughness.
faces.flavorText:
"Feel the burn of the mists. Master them. They will devour your enemies."
—Geth, keeper of the Vault

faces.name: Dimir Informant
faces.oracleText: When this creature enters, surveil 2. (Look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)
faces.flavorText: The letters arrive, all sealed and read.

faces.name: Dinotomaton
faces.oracleText:
Menace (This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
When this creature enters, target creature you control gains menace until end of turn.
faces.flavorText:
"Oh, Saheeli would *love* you."
—Huatli

faces.name: Dire Tactics
faces.oracleText: Exile target creature. If you don't control a Human, you lose life equal to that creature's toughness.
faces.flavorText:
"I will preserve human life at all costs. I will stand alone against behemoths before I let them touch my city. I will hold the wall."
—Oath of the Coppercoats

faces.name: Diresight
faces.oracleText: Surveil 2, then draw two cards. You lose 2 life. (To surveil 2, look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)
faces.flavorText: Avatar Roku showed Aang the truth behind Sozin's Comet.

faces.name: Disarm
faces.oracleText: Unattach all Equipment from target creature.
faces.flavorText: "Be thankful I left you your clothes."

faces.name: Disempower
faces.oracleText: Put target artifact or enchantment on top of its owner's library.
faces.flavorText:
"Mangara is gone. Who among you doubts that I have taken his power?"
—Kaervek

faces.name: Disorder
faces.oracleText: Disorder deals 2 damage to each white creature and each player who controls a white creature.
faces.flavorText:
"Then, just when the other guys were winnin', the sky threw up."
—Jula, goblin raider

faces.name: Dispersal Shield
faces.oracleText: Counter target spell if its mana value is less than or equal to the greatest mana value among permanents you control.
faces.flavorText: "Maybe next time."

faces.name: Displacement Wave
faces.oracleText: Return all nonland permanents with mana value X or less to their owners' hands.
faces.flavorText: The sea respects no boundaries, least of all the coast.

faces.name: Divine Offering
faces.oracleText: Destroy target artifact. You gain life equal to its mana value.

faces.name: Dogpile
faces.oracleText: Dogpile deals damage to any target equal to the number of attacking creatures you control.
faces.flavorText: There is no shelter from this storm, its rain of fists, or the thunderous cackles of bloodlust.

faces.name: Donate
faces.oracleText: Target player gains control of target permanent you control.
faces.flavorText: Campus pranksters initiate new students with the old "beeble bomb" routine.

faces.name: Double Trouble
faces.oracleText: Double the power of each creature you control until end of turn.
faces.flavorText:
"Keep up, Spider-Man. We don't have all night!"
—Ghost-Spider, Gwen Stacy

faces.name: Douse in Gloom
faces.oracleText: Douse in Gloom deals 2 damage to target creature and you gain 2 life.
faces.flavorText: Orzhov prisoners are steeped in a blackened brew that robs their souls of strength. Patriarchs drink that brew to extend their own lives.

faces.name: Drag Down
faces.oracleText: Domain — Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn for each basic land type among lands you control.
faces.flavorText: The barbarians of Jund believe the bottomless tar pits extend forever into other, darker worlds.

faces.name: Drag to the Bottom
faces.oracleText: Domain — Each creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is 1 plus the number of basic land types among lands you control.

faces.name: Dramatic Reversal
faces.oracleText: Untap all nonland permanents you control.
faces.flavorText:
"I beat you all before and I'll do it again!"
—Toph

faces.name: Drown in Sorrow
faces.oracleText: All creatures get -2/-2 until end of turn. Scry 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card on the bottom.)

faces.name: Dry Spell
faces.oracleText: Dry Spell deals 1 damage to each creature and each player.
faces.flavorText:
"Wherever water is lacking, all things suffer."
—Autumn Willow

faces.name: Dust to Dust
faces.oracleText: Exile two target artifacts.
faces.flavorText:
"All this nonsense made by mages
Rusts and crumbles through the ages."
—Aline Corralurn, "Inheritance"

faces.name: Dwarven Catapult
faces.oracleText: Dwarven Catapult deals X damage divided evenly, rounded down, among all creatures target opponent controls.
faces.flavorText:
"Often greatly outnumbered in battle, Dwarves relied on catapults as one means of damaging a large army."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

faces.name: Early Harvest
faces.oracleText: Target player untaps all basic lands they control.
faces.flavorText:
"Earth's increase, foison plenty,
Barns and garners never empty:
Vines with clust'ring bunches growing;
Plants with goodly burden bowing."
—William Shakespeare, *The Tempest*

faces.name: Earth Tremor
faces.oracleText: Earth Tremor deals damage to target creature or planeswalker equal to the number of lands you control.
faces.flavorText:
"Every cave-in is Moradin telling you to leave the earth where it is."
—Halgar, dwarven recluse

faces.name: Earthquake
faces.oracleText: Earthquake deals X damage to each creature without flying and each player.

faces.name: Echoing Calm
faces.oracleText: Destroy target enchantment and all other enchantments with the same name as that enchantment.
faces.flavorText: A single light unleashes a hail of cleansing.

faces.name: Echoing Courage
faces.oracleText: Target creature and all other creatures with the same name as that creature get +2/+2 until end of turn.
faces.flavorText: A single seed unleashes a flurry of growth.

faces.name: Echoing Decay
faces.oracleText: Target creature and all other creatures with the same name as that creature get -2/-2 until end of turn.
faces.flavorText: A single fear unleashes a torrent of nightmares.

faces.name: Echoing Ruin
faces.oracleText: Destroy target artifact and all other artifacts with the same name as that artifact.
faces.flavorText: A single misstep unleashes an avalanche of ruin.

faces.name: Eldritch Pact
faces.oracleText: Target player draws X cards and loses X life, where X is the number of cards in their graveyard.

faces.name: Elegant Parlor
faces.oracleText:
({T}: Add {R} or {W}.)
This land enters tapped.
When this land enters, surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)

faces.name: Elvish Herder
faces.oracleText: {G}: Target creature gains trample until end of turn.
faces.flavorText: Before Urza and Mishra came to Argoth, the herders prevented their creatures from stampeding. During the war, they encouraged it.

faces.name: Empty the Catacombs
faces.oracleText: Each player returns all creature cards from their graveyard to their hand.
faces.flavorText: When the dead are laid to rest in Ravnica, it's usually just a nap.

faces.name: End Hostilities
faces.oracleText: Destroy all creatures and all permanents attached to creatures.
faces.flavorText: Her palm flared like the eye of a waking dragon. Then all was calm.

faces.name: End the Festivities
faces.oracleText: End the Festivities deals 1 damage to each opponent and each creature and planeswalker they control.
faces.flavorText: When the defenses around Lurenbraum Fortress faltered, the Crimson Ballroom received some unexpected guests.

faces.name: Engulf the Shore
faces.oracleText: Return to their owners' hands all creatures with toughness less than or equal to the number of Islands you control.
faces.flavorText:
"The tides have begun to ignore the moon."
—Tamiyo's journal

faces.name: Enrage
faces.oracleText: Target creature gets +X/+0 until end of turn.
faces.flavorText: "You wouldn't like me when I'm angry."

faces.name: Epic Confrontation
faces.oracleText: Target creature you control gets +1/+2 until end of turn. It fights target creature you don't control. (Each deals damage equal to its power to the other.)
faces.flavorText: No matter the timeline, some legends will endure.

faces.name: Essence Backlash
faces.oracleText: Counter target creature spell. Essence Backlash deals damage equal to that spell's power to its controller.
faces.flavorText:
"The other guilds will learn the hard way not to interfere with our investigations."
—Bori Andon, Izzet blastseeker

faces.name: Essence Drain
faces.oracleText: Essence Drain deals 3 damage to any target and you gain 3 life.
faces.flavorText:
"Life's essence is a nectar unlike any I tasted when I lived as a mortal."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

faces.name: Essence Extraction
faces.oracleText: Essence Extraction deals 3 damage to target creature and you gain 3 life.

faces.name: Essence Harvest
faces.oracleText: Target player loses X life and you gain X life, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control.
faces.flavorText: Captain Lewenheart uncovered evidence of a demon cult among the clergy. The Skirsdag never gave him a chance to prove his case.

faces.name: Eternal Flame
faces.oracleText: Eternal Flame deals X damage to target opponent or planeswalker and half X damage, rounded up, to you, where X is the number of Mountains you control.

faces.name: Evacuation
faces.oracleText: Return all creatures to their owners' hands.
faces.flavorText: Which is more unsettling: the roar of battle or the silence that follows?

faces.name: Evaporate
faces.oracleText: Evaporate deals 1 damage to each white and/or blue creature.
faces.flavorText:
"The body is a temple with a foundation of sand."
—Autumn Willow

faces.name: Excommunicate
faces.oracleText: Put target creature on top of its owner's library.
faces.flavorText:
"Our law prohibits capital punishment. We believe even the gravest offenders have the chance to redeem themselves."
—Torian Sha, soul warden

faces.name: Exotic Disease
faces.oracleText: Domain — Target player loses X life and you gain X life, where X is the number of basic land types among lands you control.
faces.flavorText:
"Do not fear death. I shall release you from the eternal bonds and bring you glory."
—Lord Dralnu

faces.name: Exponential Growth
faces.oracleText: Until end of turn, double target creature's power X times.

faces.name: Exsanguinate
faces.oracleText: Each opponent loses X life. You gain life equal to the life lost this way.
faces.flavorText: Vampires don't consider patience a virtue nor gluttony a sin.

faces.name: Extinguish All Hope
faces.oracleText: Destroy all nonenchantment creatures.
faces.flavorText: Phenax, god of deception, offered the soldiers protection from every poison on Theros. He saw no need to mention that Pharika's poisons were drawn from Nyx.

faces.name: Extinguish the Light
faces.oracleText: Destroy target creature or planeswalker. If its mana value was 3 or less, you gain 3 life.
faces.flavorText: Jaya did not want to die, but of all the things to die for, Dominaria felt right.

faces.name: Eye Gouge
faces.oracleText: Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn. If it's a Cyclops, destroy it.
faces.flavorText: One chance. One throw. One perfect hit.

faces.name: Eyeblight Massacre
faces.oracleText: Non-Elf creatures get -2/-2 until end of turn.
faces.flavorText:
"I've already seen so much evil, so much darkness. Why do you insist on adding more?"
—Nissa Revane, to Dwynen

faces.name: Fading Hope
faces.oracleText: Return target creature to its owner's hand. If its mana value was 3 or less, scry 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card on the bottom.)
faces.flavorText: "At least I won't become one of . . . those things."

faces.name: Faerie Seer
faces.oracleText:
Flying
When this creature enters, scry 2. (Look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them on the bottom and the rest on top in any order.)

faces.name: Fallow Earth
faces.oracleText: Put target land on top of its owner's library.
faces.flavorText:
". . . and when the farmer awoke the next morning, all the seeds from his field were once again in their sacks."
—Afari, *Tales*

faces.name: False Mourning
faces.oracleText: Put target card from your graveyard on top of your library.
faces.flavorText: Zhou Yu, Sun Ce, and other famous generals feigned their deaths in order to later surprise their opponents.

faces.name: Famine
faces.oracleText: Famine deals 3 damage to each creature and each player.
faces.flavorText: "But it was a year of dearth. People were reduced to eating leaves of jujube trees. Corpses were seen everywhere in the countryside."

faces.name: Fated Conflagration
faces.oracleText: Fated Conflagration deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If it's your turn, scry 2.

faces.name: Fated Retribution
faces.oracleText: Destroy all creatures and planeswalkers. If it's your turn, scry 2.

faces.name: Fateful Absence
faces.oracleText: Destroy target creature or planeswalker. Its controller investigates. (Create a Clue token. It's an artifact with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")

faces.name: Fateful Showdown
faces.oracleText: Fateful Showdown deals damage to any target equal to the number of cards in your hand. Discard all the cards in your hand, then draw that many cards.
faces.flavorText: Tonight at the Grand Exhibition, witness Head Judge Tezzeret face off against the infamous renegade Pia Nalaar.

faces.name: Fault Line
faces.oracleText: Fault Line deals X damage to each creature without flying and each player.
faces.flavorText:
We live on the serpent's back.
—Viashino saying

faces.name: Fear of Surveillance
faces.oracleText:
Vigilance
Whenever this creature attacks, surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)
faces.flavorText: Its unblinking gaze sees every flaw, every shame, every humiliating moment you wish you could forget.

faces.name: Cyclops of One-Eyed Pass
faces.flavorText:
The Champion armed herself to face the cyclops, heedless of her companions' despair. "How will you defeat it with only one spear?" asked young Althemone. The Champion raised her weapon. "It has but one eye."
—*The Theriad*

faces.name: Feast of Flesh
faces.oracleText: Feast of Flesh deals X damage to target creature and you gain X life, where X is 1 plus the number of cards named Feast of Flesh in all graveyards.
faces.flavorText:
"Starving an army that feeds on its enemies is a sound strategy."
—Garza Zol, plague queen

faces.name: Feed the Swarm
faces.oracleText: Destroy target creature or enchantment an opponent controls. You lose life equal to that permanent's mana value.
faces.flavorText:
"We have found many of our folk lying slain as they fled thither."
—Rider of Rohan

faces.name: Feedback Bolt
faces.oracleText: Feedback Bolt deals damage to target player or planeswalker equal to the number of artifacts you control.
faces.flavorText: The path of least resistance is often through your enemies.

faces.name: Feeding Frenzy
faces.oracleText: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of Zombies on the battlefield.
faces.flavorText: It wasn't as much a strategy as a dim instinct to drown their prey.

faces.name: Festergloom
faces.oracleText: Nonblack creatures get -1/-1 until end of turn.
faces.flavorText: The death of a scout can be as informative as a safe return.

faces.name: Festival of Trokin
faces.oracleText: You gain 2 life for each creature you control.
faces.flavorText: Everyone loves a good sale.

faces.name: Festive Funeral
faces.oracleText: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of cards in your graveyard.
faces.flavorText:
"Even as we mourn the last, we look to the next with joy. Hopefully, my new suitor will bring the Cauldron home."
—Ayara, First of Locthwain

faces.name: Fields of Strife
faces.oracleText:
This land enters tapped.
{T}: Add {R} or {W}.
{2}{R}{W}, {T}: Surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)
faces.flavorText: The terrible Blood Age lives on in the unending battle between thousands of spirits trapped in their final moments.

faces.name: Fiery Cannonade
faces.oracleText: Fiery Cannonade deals 2 damage to each non-Pirate creature.
faces.flavorText: Wary of the ferocious dinosaurs, the Legion of Dusk built up the walls of their fort—just in time for the pirates to burn them down.

faces.name: Fight to the Death
faces.oracleText: Destroy all blocking creatures and all blocked creatures.
faces.flavorText: When a battlefield falls silent, it's rarely due to a cease-fire.

faces.name: Filigree Fracture
faces.oracleText: Destroy target artifact or enchantment. If that permanent was blue or black, draw a card.
faces.flavorText: The sphinx tyrannized Bant until a rhox mage tested the hardiness of her shiny parts.

faces.name: Filter Out
faces.oracleText: Return all noncreature, nonland permanents to their owners' hands.
faces.flavorText: The glistening oil had been rendered inert, but planes wouldn't begin to truly heal until every last drop was purged.

faces.name: Final Judgment
faces.oracleText: Exile all creatures.
faces.flavorText:
"The clashing warriors turned to face O-Kagachi, the greatest kami, and their sigh of awe was their last breath."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

faces.name: Fire Tempest
faces.oracleText: Fire Tempest deals 6 damage to each creature and each player.

faces.name: First Volley
faces.oracleText: First Volley deals 1 damage to target creature and 1 damage to that creature's controller.
faces.flavorText:
"We searched their bodies for signs of the blades that had killed them, but found nothing more than scorched flesh."
—Tender-Hand, kitsune healer

faces.name: Fissure
faces.oracleText: Destroy target creature or land. It can't be regenerated.
faces.flavorText:
"Must not all things at the last be swallowed up in death?"
—Plato, Phædo, trans. Jowett

faces.name: Flame Burst
faces.oracleText: Flame Burst deals X damage to any target, where X is 2 plus the number of cards named Flame Burst in all graveyards.
faces.flavorText: As hot as a dwarf's rage.

faces.name: Flame Rift
faces.oracleText: Flame Rift deals 4 damage to each player.
faces.flavorText: Crovax hungered for power, and the stronghold devoured the sky.

faces.name: Flame Sweep
faces.oracleText: Flame Sweep deals 2 damage to each creature except for creatures you control with flying.
faces.flavorText:
"I have calculated that a dragon in flight, in a single strafing run, can cover an area of—"
—Thaedus the Clever, last words

faces.name: Flame Wave
faces.oracleText: Flame Wave deals 4 damage to target player or planeswalker and each creature that player or that planeswalker's controller controls.
faces.flavorText:
"I hear the roaring of a wave whose waters are red and whose mists are black."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

faces.name: Flames of the Raze-Boar
faces.oracleText: Flames of the Raze-Boar deals 4 damage to target creature an opponent controls. Then Flames of the Raze-Boar deals 2 damage to each other creature that player controls if you control a creature with power 4 or greater.
faces.flavorText: "Fire will cure a multitude of ills."

faces.name: Flashfires
faces.oracleText: Destroy all Plains.
faces.flavorText: Dry grass is tinder before the spark.

faces.name: Flay Essence
faces.oracleText: Exile target creature or planeswalker. You gain life equal to the number of counters on it.
faces.flavorText:
